title: The sleep framework: A new way for LLMs to retain knowledge in continual learning
summary: Education Innovation；The sleep framework: A new way for LLMs to retain knowledge in continual learning

fact.subject: Google Research
fact.object: 大模型持续学习的 sleep framework

evidence.quote: We introduce a sleep phase in continual learning, enabling large language models to continuously integrate new facts and enhance reasoning while mitigating catastrophic forgetting or static knowledge cutoffs.
alternating between active interaction and offline memory consolidation allows LLMs to continuously acquire new facts, retain long-context knowledge up to 10M tokens, and improve complex reasoning.
our framework operates entirely within a fixed model architecture and human-defined training rules.

displayTitle: Google Research 提出大模型持续学习的“睡眠”框架
narrative: Google Research 在新研究介绍中提出交替的活跃与离线整合阶段：模型将短期上下文转入可更新的长期参数，以缓解持续学习中的遗忘。团队报告了长上下文知识保留和推理实验，但这是研究框架与实验结果，尚非现成商用 Agent 的自动学习能力。若后续能复现，模型更新成本和数据边界都将成为部署问题。

eventRelation.reason: 本期新增 Google Research 的研究说明；不把既有持续学习领域研究写成今日首次发现。
